faq_checkin_q: How does shift check-in and clock-out work?
faq_checkin_a: Tap the "Clock In Now" button on your Home screen. The app verifies your location against office geofences or records your field shift. When your duty ends, tap "Clock Out Shift" to finalize your shift hours.
faq_location_q: Why does the app require "Allow all the time" location access?
faq_location_a: Enterprise HRMS verifies your presence inside office geofence boundaries and logs travel routes for field personnel while working. Telemetry is ONLY recorded during active shift hours while you are Clocked In. Tracking immediately halts when you Clock Out.
faq_battery_q: Why is Battery Saver Optimization exemption needed?
faq_battery_a: Modern Android operating systems aggressively kill background applications to save power. Excluding HRMS from battery optimization prevents the OS from stopping your active shift tracking midway.
faq_gps_q: What should I do if my location shows "GPS Disabled"?
faq_gps_a: Ensure your phone's Location/GPS switch is turned ON with "High Accuracy" enabled in Android settings. You can run the Permission Setup Wizard from App Settings to verify.
faq_leave_q: How do I apply for annual leave or check holidays?
faq_leave_a: Navigate to the "Leaves" tab to submit leave requests, view remaining balances, or tap "View Calendar" on the Home dashboard to see your location-specific holiday schedule.
faq_regularize_q: Who can I contact if my attendance record needs regularization?
faq_regularize_a: You can submit a ticket under the "Attendance & Shift" category on this Help Desk page or message your HR Administrator directly via the Chat tab.
